title: Swego / Centerport
summary: Swego is a Huntington locality recorded in a 1771 town order. A Town of Huntington historical marker identifies the name with this Centerport area on Fort Salonga Road.
address_label: Fort Salonga Road near Stony Hollow Road, Centerport, NY
map_geometry_source: Town of Huntington Historian's Office Swego marker location, documented by the Historical Marker Database.
why_this_matters: The surviving town marker turns Swego from a broad Huntington reference into a mappable Centerport locality. The listing also shows how a location can be secure even when competing historical interpretations of a name remain unsettled.
introduction_content: The 1771 record refers to Jonah Wood's house at Swego during a smallpox-related order. A historical marker erected by the Town of Huntington Historian's Office in 1986 supplies a surviving modern location for the locality.
history_content: The marker stands on Fort Salonga Road west of Stony Hollow Road in Centerport. It connects Swego with the nearby stream landscape also recorded as Opcatkontycke, described on the marker as the Wading Place Creek.
translation_content: Tooker cautiously suggested that Swego might be a shortened or imported form of Oswego, associated with flowing out or an outlet. The later town marker gives a similar flowing-out interpretation, but the name's exact linguistic history should remain qualified.
preservation_content: This draft keeps the references available while separating uncertain imported terminology from publishable local placename records.
whereintheworld_content: The marker uses the documented location of the Town of Huntington's Swego historical sign on Fort Salonga Road in Centerport.
